consequence.statement: Policy reports now also record results for mutate, mutateExisting and generate rules. If the reports controller has not been granted the needed RBAC permissions, admitting a policy returns a warning message.
consequence.remediation: Grant the reports controller the RBAC permissions it needs for the new report types, or set --enableReporting to only the rule types you want reported.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds the container flag --enableReporting, which chooses which rule types are reported (validate, mutate, mutateExisting, generate, imageVerify). Reporting now also covers mutate and generate rules, and the chart default enables all five types.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for cli-flag added
